regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-speed rotation: 'Memory, HBM & Storage' leads with a wide margin over 'AI Infrastructure', with eligible themes spanning half the universe (25/49) and no one-narrative dominance. Gate_helps is true, so the absolute-trend discipline has historically cut drawdown on this market, but rank-IC is ~0 and rotation timing is display-only — no forward edge is claimed. Macro backdrop is coincident geopolitical/markets/ai_tech chatter with full unscheduled surprise, providing no buy trigger.
emerging_watch: Watching 'AI Infrastructure' (rank 2, challenger with score 1.745, margin to leader 0.595) for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff — the condition to retire this watch is Memory/HBM's score falling below AI Infrastructure's score and staying there for two consecutive detector prints while both remain eligible.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: This is the confirmed leader with the strongest score and broad breadth (0.75), eligible under the absolute-trend gate. The trend-gate leg (the only validated risk-control edge) supports staying with the established leader rather than rotating out; durability/cohesion are coincident but not hostile. Momentum rank is treated as attention, not a forecast, so the lean is a low-conviction expression of trend discipline rather than a predictive call.
theses.dissent: The rank itself has ~0 forward IC, and 'mixed' hurst_tag on the headline means the trend may be choppy rather than persistent; staying in the leader is discipline, not a reason to expect outperformance over this horizon.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 5% or more before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity scores highly (rank 3) and has the strongest durability_bar (0.76) with trend hurst and high breadth (0.90), but crowding_z=1.82 flags it as crowded. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — not a fade or short. An 'avoid' lean reflects not adding fresh exposure to a crowded high-attention theme with no basket-level forward edge, while explicitly declining to fade it.
evidence: guardrails: crowding DOWN-SIZES, never a sell/short/fade
theses.dissent: High breadth and a trend hurst tag mean the theme is technically healthy; crowding is coincident and has no validated forward edge for baskets, so an avoid could underperform if the trend simply continues.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms the S&P 500 by 5% or more without a drawdown shake-out before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: AI Semiconductors is eligible, shows the strongest durability_bar (0.85) and highest breadth (0.917) in the top ranks, with a 'trend' hurst tag and no crowding (z=0.69). The trend-gate leg supports holding this as a durable, broad-based trend theme. Momentum score (1.083) is weaker than the leader but the structural trend-health legs are the strongest available, justifying a low-conviction overweight on staying-power rather than prediction.
theses.dissent: Its momentum rank is middling (5th) and the proxy (SMH) overlaps heavily with the leader and AI Infrastructure, so the overweight may be redundant rather than diversifying; there is no rank-based return edge to lean on.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 8% or more before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
